summary: Daily Summary & End-of-Day Report feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest passed covering auth guards, live summary payload (today + zero-activity past date), generate snapshot (no-email, send_email with no recipients => skipped_no_recipients, with recipients => sent), history sort + date_from/date_to filter, GET/DELETE snapshot + 404s, delivery-settings defaults/patch/email lowercasing/invalid send_at 400, and the critical router ordering check (delivery-settings not caught by /{sid}). Frontend: /admin/daily-summary page renders fully with every required data-testid (KPI cards, fulfillment mix, customers bar, top items, issues, LW/MoM comparisons, history, delivery settings, MOCKED badge). Generate snapshot → history row appears; Add Recipient prompt → chip rendered and lowercased; save toast shown. Print mode /admin/daily-summary?print=1 hides action bar + history + delivery-settings sections and auto-invokes window.print() after 500ms. Admin sidebar has 'Daily Summary' entry. Cleanup: generated snapshots were deleted via UI and API; delivery settings reset to defaults.
critical_code_review_comments: daily_summary.py cleanly declares /delivery-settings routes before /{sid} — router order verified and tested.

_compute_daily_summary scans db.orders for earlier_keys without a date index filter but only projects {user_id, contact_email}; fine at MVP scale, could become expensive with large history — consider capping lookback (e.g., last 180 days) for returning/new customer detection.

POST /daily-summary/generate always inserts a new snapshot (history grows unbounded). A docstring mentions 'Upsert by date (latest wins)' but code does insert_one — either update docstring or add optional upsert-by-date behavior to prevent duplicates when re-generating the same day.
Email is clearly MOCKED — delivery_log records mocked:true and logger.info is emitted. MOCKED badge visible in UI. Good.
AdminDailySummary.js silently swallows errors in loadHistory/loadSettings via empty catch — fine but could surface a toast when the page is opened and requests fail unexpectedly.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 snapshots during tests for dates 2020-01-02/03/04; cleaned up in teardown. Delivery-settings reset to {enabled:false, recipients:[], send_at:'21:00', format:'pdf'} at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_daily_summary.py uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var; run with `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && pytest backend/tests/test_daily_summary.py -v`. Router ordering test included. Email remains MOCKED — do not attempt real SMTP validation.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All features work as specified.
